CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red) identified and its organization/status (origin) are both explicitly recorded for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Content (red positions) and an attribute are explicitly identified in the structured report.

D.rationale: The report separately records content identity (red) and its status/organization (origin) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The origin/record metadata explicitly describes how the content instance is organized/presented for the referent/time.
